description: This file contains the implementation of the Crypt_Blowfish class, which provides encryption and decryption functionalities using the Blowfish algorithm. It includes methods for setting a secret key, encrypting and decrypting data, and internal logic for cipher operations.

classes.name: Crypt_Blowfish
classes.description: A class implementing Blowfish encryption and decryption without relying on external PHP extensions like mcrypt. It supports key setup, encryption, decryption, and internal cipher logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Crypt_Blowfish object with a secret key.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key for encryption/decryption, initializing the subkeys and S-boxes.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext string into cipher text.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the internal P-array and S-boxes with default key data.
